verification_questions.question: Does POST /api/drawers accept {wing, room, content, metadata} and return 201 with {success, drawer_id}?
Does POST /api/drawers store custom metadata (source_url, title, hall, timestamp) in ChromaDB?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_create_drawer_stores_custom_metadata creates a drawer and verifies source_url and title via by-url lookup

verification_questions.question: Does PUT /api/drawers/{id} update content and metadata, returning 200?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_update_drawer_content and test_update_drawer_metadata verify both cases

verification_questions.question: Does PUT /api/drawers/{id} return 404 for nonexistent drawer?
Does DELETE /api/drawers/{id} return 200 on success and 404 on not found?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, test_delete_drawer_success and test_delete_drawer_not_found verify both

verification_questions.question: Are Pydantic models used for request/response validation?
verification_questions.expected: Yes, CreateDrawerRequest, UpdateDrawerRequest, DrawerMetadata models with field validation. test_create_drawer_missing_required_fields verifies 422 on invalid input.
